(def ^:private throw-no-method-error
  (fn [name dispatch-val]
    (throw (suss.bootstrap/error
             (str "No method in multimethod '" name "' for dispatch value: "
                  ((fn [v] (if (nil? v) "null" (try (str v) (catch :default _ (pr-str v))))) dispatch-val))))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn- to a private def/fn (#30). Messages are Clojure's. Clojure formats each dispatch value with String.format's %s, which calls toString; Suss uses str, with "null" for nil, and pr-str for a value str cannot format, such as a host type.
